theorems.name: Submission.codim1_rdo_dg_flat_tangent_density_cone
theorems.statement: ∀ (m : ℕ) (μ : Measure (Euclid (m + 1))) (y v : Euclid (m + 1)), 1 ≤ m → ‖v‖ = 1 → (∃ r₀ : ℝ, 0 < r₀ ∧ μ (closedBall y r₀) ≠ ∞) → (∀ f : Euclid (m + 1) → ℝ, Continuous f → HasCompactSupport f → Tendsto (fun r : ℝ => (r ^ m)⁻¹ * ∫ z, f (r⁻¹ • (z - y)) ∂μ) (𝓝[>] 0) (𝓝 (∫ z in ((Submodule.span ℝ {v})ᗮ : Set (Euclid (m + 1))), f z ∂μHE[m]))) → Tendsto (fun r : ℝ => μ (closedBall y r) / (unitBallVolume m * ENNReal.ofReal (r ^ m))) (𝓝[>] 0) (𝓝 1) ∧ Tendsto (fun r : ℝ => μ (ball y r) / (unitBallVolume m * ENNReal.ofReal (r ^ m))) (𝓝[>] 0) (𝓝 1) ∧ ∀ α : ℝ, 0 < α → Tendsto (fun r : ℝ => μ ({z | α * ‖z - y‖ ≤ |inner ℝ (z - y) v|} ∩ closedBall y r) / ENNReal.ofReal (r ^ m)) (𝓝[>] 0) (𝓝 0)
